title: Breaking mBad! Supervised Fine-tuning for Cross-Lingual Detoxification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in toxicity reduction and model perplexity across seven typologically diverse languages (e.g., English, German, Spanish, Hindi, Chinese, Russian, Arabic) using the Perspective API, specifically measuring how the effectiveness of cross-lingual detoxification fine-tuning varies based on linguistic families and script similarities.
